items.exampleEn: The logo on her bag is very famous.
items.exampleZh: 她包包上的商標非常有名。

items.exampleEn: This TV series has five seasons.
The setting of the story is a small island.
items.exampleZh: 這個故事的背景是一座小島。

items.exampleEn: The journalist wrote an article about the new park.
items.exampleZh: 那位記者寫了一篇關於新公園的報導。

items.exampleEn: My uncle reads a medical journal every month.
items.exampleZh: 我叔叔每個月都看一本醫學期刊。

items.exampleEn: He has never spoken publicly about his family.
items.exampleZh: 他從來沒有公開談論過他的家人。

items.exampleEn: The publisher will print five thousand copies.
My favorite columnist stopped writing last year.
items.exampleZh: 我最喜歡的專欄作家去年停筆了。

items.exampleEn: The interviewee answered the reporter's questions clearly.
items.exampleZh: 受訪者清楚地回答了記者的問題。

items.exampleEn: Keep your CV short and clear.

items.sentenceEn: Her CV is two pages long.

items.audioEn: Please email your CV before Friday; we will call you for an interview next week.
items.audioZh: 請在星期五前用電子郵件寄履歷；我們下週會打電話通知你面試。
items.questionZh: 要在什麼時候前寄履歷？
options: By the end of next week

items.sentenceEn: The museum has a series of talks about art this month.
items.sentenceZh: 博物館這個月有一系列藝術講座。

items.sentenceEn: The castle is a perfect setting for a wedding.
items.sentenceZh: 那座城堡是舉辦婚禮的完美場地。

items.stemEn: The ____ asked the actor many questions for the newspaper.
items.stemZh: 那位記者為了報紙問了那位演員很多問題。

items.stemEn: Every bottle has the team's ____ on it.
items.stemZh: 每個瓶子上都有隊伍的標誌。

items.passageEn: My sister wants to become a journalist. Last month, she sent her CV to a small publisher that publishes a monthly science journal. The office was in a quiet setting by the river. At the interview, she was the only interviewee who brought her own articles. The manager showed her the company's new logo and talked about a new series of books for children. She also met a columnist who writes about food every week. A week later, the company publicly announced that she got the job.
items.passageZh: 我的姊妹想當記者。上個月，她把履歷寄給一家出版科學月刊的小出版社。辦公室位在河邊一個安靜的環境裡。面試時，她是唯一帶著自己寫的文章去的面試者。經理給她看公司的新商標，還談到一套新的兒童系列書籍。她也見到一位每週寫美食專欄的作家。一個星期後，公司公開宣布她錄取了。

questions.questionZh: 面試時她和其他人有什麼不同？
options: 只有她帶了自己寫的文章

questions.questionZh: 公司後來怎麼宣布結果？
options: 在雜誌上登了一則長廣告
寄了一封很長的信給她

items.promptZh: 這家出版社專門出版童書。
referenceEn: This publisher only publishes children's books.
The publisher publishes only books for children.
rubricZh: publisher 表示「出版社」，可數名詞，例如 this publisher 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.promptZh: 她的研究發表在一份科學期刊上。
referenceEn: Her research was published in a science journal.
Her study appeared in a scientific journal.
rubricZh: 「發表」可寫，例如 was published in、appeared in 等
